source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: Aadhaar OR "India Stack" OR "digital public infrastructure" OR "digital public goods" OR "Unique Identification Authority" OR "identification for development" OR ID4D
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:Aadhaar OR "India Stack" OR "digital public infrastructure" OR "digital public goods" OR "Unique Identification Authority" OR "identification for development" OR ID4D,is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("Aadhaar" OR "ID4D" OR "India Stack" OR "Unique Identification Authority" OR "digital public goods" OR "digital public infrastructure" OR "identification for development")
